'''Inivon''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] of the [[House of Organa/Legends|House Organa]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] living during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. During the [[Alderaan Civil War]] in [[3643 BBY]] he served under Lieutenant [[Dargus]] and was along with the rest of his men holding the [[House Ulgo]] forces at the [[Dassel Pass]]. General [[Gesselle Organa]] send them reinforcements in form of a [[Empire's Wrath|Sith Lord]], who agreed to help them in exchange for information. Inivon did not trust the Sith and attempted to leave with his men.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Sergeant Inivon appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during the Sith Warrior class mission on Alderaan if the player makes the light side choice in conversation with Gesselle Organa. He is voiced by [[Troy Hall]].
